response.justification: Bogdan Szabo's resume shows extensive experience in software development across multiple languages (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Java, etc.) and domains (web, mobile, embedded), but lacks direct experience with C++ at the required depth for this role. His work leans heavily toward high-level scripting and frontend/backend frameworks rather than low-level system programming, networking, or industrial automation-specific technologies (e.g., message brokers, multi-threading, IEC standards). While he demonstrates strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and leadership, the absence of C++ proficiency and industrial cybersecurity exposure significantly reduces his fit for this role.
strengths: Strong software engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Experience with scalable, event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective platform)
Leadership in mentoring and community engagement (workshops, open-source contributions)
concerns: Minimal or no hands-on C++ experience in recent roles
No evidence of industrial automation, IoT, or protocol knowledge (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, etc.)
Limited exposure to Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards
